title: Smart Data Models - SIMPLE Federated Business Service - Shipment
description: A business transaction with a carrier for the transport of goods or containers from one location to another, where all goods and containers have to arrive in a given time period (businessService:Shipment, FEDeRATED Business Service ontology). Similar to a Consignment, but always with a carrier acting as service provider. Extended by the SIMPLE project with delivery time windows, arrival/departure location, a relationship to its constituent Consignments, and an eFTI UID for EU-Gate interoperability. NOTE: unlike Consignment, the base ontology asserts Shipment as a direct subclass of owl:Thing, not of BusinessTransaction -- it therefore carries none of BusinessTransaction's properties.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Shipment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

eftiUid.description: Property. simple-bs:eftiUid (SIMPLE extension, added in v0.3.1). Unique identifier (UUID) of the eFTI (electronic Freight Transport Information) dataset associated to this Shipment, used for interoperability with the EU eFTI platform / EU-Gate.

earliestDeliveryTime.description: Property. simple-bs:earliestDeliveryTime (SIMPLE extension). Earliest time at which this shipment can be delivered to the final destination.

expectedDeliveryTime.description: Property. simple-bs:expectedDeliveryTime (SIMPLE extension). Expected delivery time for this shipment.

latestDeliveryTime.description: Property. simple-bs:latestDeliveryTime (SIMPLE extension). Latest time by which this shipment should be delivered to the final destination.

containsBusinessTransaction.description: Relationship. simple-bs:containsBusinessTransaction (SIMPLE extension). Relates this Shipment to the one or several Consignments it is divided into. Range: this candidate's own Consignment entity.

hasArrivalLocation.description: Relationship. simple-bs:hasArrivalLocation (SIMPLE extension, subPropertyOf businessService:hasLocation). Arrival location of this shipment. Range: DigitalTwin:PhysicalObject, per the SIMPLE ontology's own asserted range (out of scope of this candidate).

hasDepartureLocation.description: Relationship. simple-bs:hasDepartureLocation (SIMPLE extension, subPropertyOf businessService:hasLocation). Departure location of this shipment. Range: DigitalTwin:PhysicalObject (out of scope of this candidate).
